title: The Two Seasons: Encounter With A Vampire
author: Andrew Apted
description:
A missing boy.

A vampire in their midst.

A host of other tropes and clichés to enjoy.

Tag along with a pair of self-confessed "music geeks" as they investigate a mystery at their high school, in this light-hearted adventure which may not break new ground, but does threaten to poke it repeatedly with a sharp stick.
